visual_action: A slideshow of still images. First, close-up portraits of Donald Trump, Pete Hegseth, and Stephen Miller are shown sequentially. These are followed by images of three anime villains from the series 'Jujutsu Kaisen'. The video concludes with a composite image where the faces of Trump, Hegseth, and Miller have been photoshopped onto the bodies of the anime characters.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: His face appears in a still portrait at the beginning and is later superimposed onto an anime character's body.

cast.name: Pete Hegseth
cast.evidence: His face appears in a still portrait and is later superimposed onto an anime character's body.

cast.name: Stephen Miller
cast.evidence: His face appears in a still portrait and is later superimposed onto an anime character's body.

on_screen_text.text: the history book on the shelf

spoken_summary: The lyrics of the background song are sung: "The history book on the shelf is always repeating itself."
audio_music: A dramatic pop song with female vocals plays throughout. The lyrics match the on-screen text and build a narrative sense of foreboding and revelation.
editing_pacing: A slideshow of still images with simple cuts between them.
manipulation_or_satire: The faces of Donald Trump, Pete Hegseth, and Stephen Miller are superimposed onto the bodies of three anime characters to portray them as a team of villains.
cultural_references: The song 'History Repeating' by Propellerheads feat. Shirley Bassey is used.
central_claim: Donald Trump, Pete Hegseth, and Stephen Miller are a team of dangerous villains, representing a negative pattern repeating itself in history.
intended_effect: To persuade the viewer to see Donald Trump, Pete Hegseth, and Stephen Miller as a villainous and threatening group.
